name: Speed Limit's Gambit
author: Minty
summary: Moving a piece 1 tile gives $1. Moving a piece 3 or more tiles costs $3.
description: A common money gambit that rewards careful, short moves. Move a piece exactly one tile and you pocket $1; fling a piece three or more tiles and you're fined $3. Uses the 'Point A' Manager library to measure how far each piece travelled, so both that and the Gambit Creation API install alongside it.
